meta_description: Fence and gardening services in Sheffield and Rotherham. Expert fencing, garden maintenance, and landscaping. Free quotes available. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Fencing & Garden Experts — Sheffield & Rotherham
hero_subhead: From broken fences to overgrown gardens, we handle everything. Same-week appointments available across Sheffield and Rotherham.
services_heading: Complete Fencing & Gardening Services Across Sheffield & Rotherham
services_subhead: Whether you need a new fence, garden redesign, or regular maintenance, we deliver professional results at fair prices.

services.title: Fence Installation & Repair
services.desc: We build strong, attractive fences that last — from timber panels to composite and metal options. Repairs and replacements handled quickly, often completed in one visit.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Up
services.desc: Overgrown garden getting you down? We clear dead plants, prune trees and shrubs, remove garden waste, and leave your space clean and ready to use.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cuts keep your boundaries neat and your neighbours happy. We handle all heights and types of hedging, with debris removed same day.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Create a usable outdoor space with a new patio or timber deck. We design, build, and finish to suit your garden and budget.

services.title: Grass Cutting & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly, fortnightly, or one-off cuts — we keep your lawn healthy and tidy. Scarifying, overseeding, and moss treatment available too.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Turn your vision into reality. We design gardens that are practical, attractive, and built to last, with planting schemes tailored to your soil and sunlight.

about_pullquote: We built this business because Sheffield gardens deserve better than neglect.
about_para_1: For over 15 years, we've been the gardeners and fencers Sheffield and Rotherham trust. We started as a one-person operation fixing neighbours' broken fences and tidying overgrown gardens. Word of mouth grew us into a small, reliable team — and that's exactly how we like it. Every job gets the same careful attention, whether it's a quick tidy or a full garden transformation.
about_para_2: We're not fancy or quick-fix. We turn up on time, do thorough work, clear up properly, and charge fair prices. Customers come back to us year after year because we listen to what they actually want and deliver it without fuss. Your garden is where your family spends time — we treat it with the respect it deserves.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield & Rotherham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our back garden was a complete jungle when we moved in. Called these lads up and they came out within a week. Cleared the lot, fixed the fence, and tidied the edges. Couldn't believe the difference. Very friendly and left the place spotless. Will definitely have them back for maintenance.
reviews.author: Martin K.

reviews.text: Had a fence panel blow down in the wind. Rang on a Friday morning and they were here the next afternoon with a replacement already fitted. Solid work, reasonable price, and they swept up all the debris. Top marks.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Been using them for grass cutting every fortnight now for about 8 months. Always arrive when they say they will, always do a proper job, and my lawn has never looked better. No cutting corners, no hidden charges. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: David P.
